source: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/neurips-2026-smart-buildings/leaderboard (public, ~33% of test data), read 2026-10-22 ~22:50 PDT via browser
metric: mean over held-out scenarios of |mean per-step reward|; lower is better
notes: Prize contenders are the top 8 (prize pool 1st-8th).

Scores are in per-step units: a scenario with total reward -208 over 8,640 steps is 0.0241 per step; the organizer pid_water baseline on the shipped training set therefore sits roughly an order of magnitude above the leaders.
Local 30-scenario metric is not identical to the Kaggle metric (held-out buildings, 33% public split), but it is the same formula.
